integrity: Proof uses a self-contained finite-dimensional transfer recurrence certificate and a direct symmetric threshold potential argument. Finite computations support, but do not replace, the recurrence proof. The first public day-specific date is for arxiv:1508.03519v1; earlier cited papers have known publication years without a verified day.
scientific_limitations: Exact counts cover initially fixed, initially two-periodic and all-vertex-flipping configurations, not eventual basin sizes or sharp transient entry times. The general eventual period bound is previously known. Historical priority could be affected by earlier unindexed results; the full 1980 source was inaccessible.
title: A mod-three resonance in the majority clocks of open ladders
